name: Buenavista de Valdavia (Spain)
description: Square flag with a blue triangle with its base along the hoist and its apex at the middle of the fly, green above and red below.
history: Municipal flag of Buenavista de Valdavia; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle along the upper edge from the upper hoist to the middle of the fly
triangle along the lower edge from the lower hoist to the middle of the fly
